example.title: Allegheny Portage Railroad, Bens Creek Culvert, State Route 53 over Bens Creek

brief: Long stone arch culvert under a high highway fill: the original 1832 railway culvert, an 18 ft elliptical arch of squared sandstone with a clear voussoir ring and straight headwall, was extended in 1855 into a 114 ft barrel that climbs with the stream bed so the inlet is only 9 ft high. Timber-plank invert inside, boulder rip-rap at the outlet, trees and brush growing on the embankment above. For the 14.6 m highway crossing, use the long barrel with a headwall at each end.

traits.railing_detail: none; embankment with roadside guardrail above
